"'
Cause You Are Young
" is the second
single
by
C. C. Catch
, released on January 20, 1986, by
Hansa
. The song was produced by German producer
Dieter Bohlen
of the duo
Modern Talking
. It was the second single from C. C. Catch's debut album
Catch the Catch
, released in 1986.
[
1
]
[
2
]
In
Germany
, "'Cause You Are Young" reached #9, becoming C. C. Catch's first song to reach the Top 10 in the country. The song became one of her most commercially successful tracks, finding additional success in
Austria
, where it reached #28, as well as peaking at #8 in both
Spain
and
Switzerland
.
